run: churn, n = 100, checkpoints every 25 children plus 0, 1, 2 and n; SPIRE agent sync_interval and server cache_reload_interval both 1 s; MAX_LIVE_CHILDREN = 200
headline: bytes on disk of the SPIRE server and vending service volumes, and the logical SQLite content (page counts, per-table dbstat bytes, row counts), against the number of children vended by exp-root; accumulate is followed by a drain (dispose all, oldest first), churn is vend-then-dispose cycles
secondary: container writable-layer bytes and memory working set (crictl), OPA grant-module count from OPA's request log, size of GET /v1/policies per vend (resp_bytes) and its projection to the policy engine's 4 MiB read limit
harness: src/experiments/storage_growth.py (reusing lib/cluster.py, revocation_speed.py and vend_to_svid.py's parts), parentsim modes vend and dispose

code.state: uncommitted working tree at run time

command: cd src/experiments && CLUSTER_NAME=nhi-lab KUBECTX=kind-bench-sg-churn-1s TRUST_DOMAIN=lab.local uv run python3 storage_growth.py --phase churn --n 100 --step 25 --run-id 20261107T181817Z-storage-growth-churn-1s

cluster.kind_cluster: bench-sg-churn-1s (throwaway, two nodes), created for this run and deleted after it
bring_up: make policy-engine-up vending-service-up resource-up experiments-fixtures-up KIND_CLUSTER=bench-sg-churn-1s
cluster.note: the config changes below were made after the last make target, because the make targets re-apply the repository's manifests; make was not run again on the cluster

config_changes_on_this_cluster_only.change: in the server block of the live spire-server ConfigMap: `audit_log_enabled = true` and `experimental { cache_reload_interval = "1s" }` (default 5 s); StatefulSet restarted
in the agent block of the live spire-agent ConfigMap: `experimental { sync_interval = "1s" }` (default 5 s); DaemonSet restarted after the server
`kubectl -n nhi set env deployment/vending-service MAX_LIVE_CHILDREN=200` (manifest default 8); Recreate rollout, the PVC persisted; checked in the running pod's spec

measurement_notes.pause: 1.0 s before each checkpoint so in-flight writes land
measurement_notes.on_disk: docker exec <node> find <pv dir> -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec stat -c '%n|%s|%b|%B'; apparent = %s, allocated = %b x %B; read from outside the pods
measurement_notes.logical: database + -wal + -shm streamed out of the node with tar into a scratch directory and opened there; dbstat gives pages, pgsize and unused per table and index
measurement_notes.writable_layer: crictl stats; the runtime refreshes writableLayer on its own period, so each value has an age column (<container>_writable_age_s)
measurement_notes.opa_modules: live count = 2xx PUTs minus DELETEs of /v1/policies/nhi_grants_* in OPA's request log (container opa); GET /v1/policies sizes = resp_bytes of its 'Sent response.' lines; no GET happens during the drain
measurement_notes.opa_diagnostic_listener: error: SSLError: [SSL: TLSV13_ALERT_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED] tlsv13 alert certificate required (_ssl.c:2660)
measurement_notes.log_bytes: container log byte counts are not measured

not_populated.opa_heap_inuse_bytes, opa_alloc_bytes: OPA's diagnostic listener (--diagnostic-addr, /metrics) also requires a client certificate: --authentication=tls applies to every listener, and the harness holds no SVID that OPA trusts (the TLS error is in opa_metrics_status). OPA's key material was not touched. The OPA in-memory footprint is therefore the crictl memory working set only (opa_mem_working_set_bytes), which is noisy (GC). The headline OPA numbers are the live module count and the GET /v1/policies resp_bytes.

idle_control: after checkpoint 0 and after the last checkpoint the run waits 30 s with no operations and takes a checkpoint (phase idle-start / idle-end); idle rows are excluded from the fits and reported as per-second changes in the summary ('idle')
